name: shirazeh.prefs
description: User preference persistence for Shirazeh (theme, language) on top of the storage infrastructure service.

provides.name: shirazeh.prefs.service
provides.description: Reads and writes the user's UI preferences. Preference values are strict JSON-compatible data. The service degrades gracefully: a missing preference reads as null, and a failed write reports false — storage problems reduce capability, they never break the UI.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the stored value of a preference, or null when it was never stored or storage failed. Records live as { key, value } in the configured collection.
methods.returns: Promise<unknown> — the stored value, or null

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a preference value. Returns true on success and false when the write failed or dependencies are unavailable.
